scoring_justification: Step_04 recomputes RMSE from raw predictions (T1); step_05 compares self-reported RMSE at 20 added points to hidden threshold (T0 fallback, but the main check is recompute).

hidden_assets.purpose: Step 04 RMSE thresholds (test set: threshold 3.5 °C, max 10.0 °C)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported test RMSE <3°C for XGBoost and ANN; added 0.5°C tolerance to set threshold; max_rmse set to 10°C (well above paper's expected measurement uncertainty ~3-5°C).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's quantitative claim and typical experimental error; tolerance chosen to absorb legitimate toolchain spread while excluding trivial failure.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly anchored to the paper's stated performance metric.

hidden_assets.purpose: Step 05 extrapolation RMSE threshold (6.0 °C) and max (12.0 °C) at 20 added points
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported extrapolation RMSE ~5°C with 20 added cloud points; added 1°C tolerance to set threshold; max_rmse set to 12°C to allow graded partial credit.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's quantitative extrapolation claim.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Anchored to the paper's stated quantitative trend.

outputs.description: Per-sample test set predictions for cloud point temperature. The verifier will compute RMSE between observed_temperature and each predicted column, then check that both RMSE values are at or below the hidden paper-derived threshold.

Extrapolation RMSE as a function of the number of added cloud points for a specific polymer. The verifier will read the RMSE value at num_added_cloud_points=20 and check that it is at or below the hidden paper-derived threshold.

output_contract.notes: The test set evaluation must be performed for both the XGBoost and ANN models. The extrapolation analysis may be conducted with the XGBoost model only, using a polymer that has few data points in the curated set.

steps.notes: Score is average of two model RMSE scores, each scored monotonically: 1.0 if rmse <= 3.5, linearly decaying to 0 at rmse = 10.0 (decay range 6.5).
Monotonic scoring: 1.0 if RMSE <= 6.0, linearly decaying to 0 at RMSE = 12.0.
